query: When was the American lawyer, lobbyist and political consultant who was a senior member of the presidential campaign of Donald Trump born?

repl_history.response:
According to the [Global Context Preview], the American lawyer, lobbyist, and political consultant who was a senior member of the presidential campaign of Donald Trump is Paul Manafort.

The preview states: "He was previously an adviser to the U.S. presidential campaigns of Republicans Gerald Ford, Ronald Reagan, George H. W. Bush, and Bob Dole.  In 1980 Manafort co-founded the Washington, D.C.-based lobbying firm Black, Manafort & Stone, along with principals Charles R. Black Jr., and Roger J. Stone."

Paul Manafort's birthdate is mentioned as April 1, 1949.

FINAL ANSWER: April 1 1949
